title: feed.xml must be fetchable over HTTP
untested_rationale: check-feeds.mjs emits this id when the live feed returns a non-2xx response or transport fails. A body fixture cannot create that condition. The production smoke test checks the route, and the scheduled B2 audit exercises fetchStable against the live origin.

spec.name: RSS 2.0
spec.normative_quote: RSS 2.0 specifies a document format. It does not define this repository's handling of transport failures while fetching feed.xml.
spec.note: No specification clause applies to this operational failure path.
spec.verification_note: Clause n/a. The quote states why this operational transport rule has no external source clause.

applicability: A live HTTP request for feed.xml.
expectation: The request succeeds with a 2xx response before body validation begins.
